title: OpenMHS simulator run record (sim.lock.json)
description: How a simulator package passed its gate on the real upstream simulator (--backend sim): the environment it was installed in, the dependency versions that resolved, and the digest of that passing report. Written after the run; CI cannot repeat it and never trusts it. It is stale, and the market ignores it, once the package's fake gate digest (RESULT.json gate.digest) or its upstream commit no longer match.

platform.description: The container platform of the run.

base_image.description: The base image the environment was built on, for example python:3.10-slim-bookworm.

system_packages.description: Operating-system packages added to the base image.

install.description: The install commands run in the source tree of the pinned commit.

constraints.description: Version pins chosen by the package author (requirement specifiers), applied to every install command.

resolved.description: Every installed distribution as name==version, as the installer reported it after the install.

digest.description: mhs.driver.check.stable_digest of the passing sim report.

warnings.description: Codes of the warnings of the passing run.

fake_gate_digest.description: RESULT.json gate.digest when this record was written.
